headline: Allegiant does not care that you went 20-of-24
dek: Patrick Mahomes threw for 246 yards in a 24-10 win at Hard Rock Stadium; Week 4 is a 3-0 AFC West road game against Las Vegas on Sun Oct 4, 3:25 PM CT, with Josh Simmons still out and Maxx Crosby across the line.
videoHook: Twenty of twenty-four. Twenty-four to ten. Miami still had the football for 34:21. That is the tape we are taking to Las Vegas.
theEdge: ESPN FPI at 70.0 percent and DraftKings listing Chiefs -4.5 on a 47.5 total is a road-favorite price against another 3-0 AFC West club; Polymarket’s 8.6 percent Super Bowl number and 16.5 percent AFC ticket are the long-view tax on winning 24-10 while Miami held 19 first downs and 34:21 of the football.

storyline.lede: Kansas City is 3-0, and the AFC West is still a two-club argument. The 24-10 win at Hard Rock Stadium was real — Mahomes 20-of-24 for 246 yards with two passing touchdowns, Kenneth Walker III’s 10-yard run 2:06 into the game, Rashee Rice’s 7 catches for 88 yards — and it was also incomplete. Eighteen first downs, 88 rushing yards, 3-of-7 on third down, and 25:39 of possession are the numbers that actually travel. The 3-0 Raiders and first-year head coach Klint Kubiak are next on Sun Oct 4, 3:25 PM CT, with the West lead through four games on the table.
body: Miami won the ugly fights and still lost the scoreboard. The Dolphins posted 19 first downs, 119 rushing yards on 31 carries, 8-of-16 on third down, and 34:21 of possession on nine drives. Kansas City answered with 334 total yards, the explosive shots (Travis Kelce 48 yards down the middle, Rice 34, Noah Gray 24, Xavier Worthy 17, Tyquan Thornton 17), a L. Sneed strip-and-recover on Malik Willis, and a Karlaftis interception. That is how you leave 24-10 without winning the clock.

The Indianapolis tape is a different movie and has to stay in its own box: 523 yards, 29 first downs, 371 net passing, 152 rushing, 37:00 of possession in a 33-30 overtime win. Miami squeezed that same offense to 88 on the ground and 25:39 with the football. Eric Bieniemy’s room now has a division road game to decide whether Walker’s 20 touches and Emmett Johnson’s 6 rushes are enough volume when Maxx Crosby is the one walking the edge.

Andy Reid already called Las Vegas ‘aggressive football,’ and Patrick Mahomes is talking ‘bragging rights’ with Crosby. Josh Simmons has a bulging disk in his lower back and has not debuted in 2026. L'Jarius Sneed was limited on the Wednesday report after playing through Miami. ESPN FPI hangs a 70.0 percent number on Kansas City; DraftKings has the Chiefs -4.5 on 47.5. That is a favorite’s price, not a sealed West. Allegiant is where 3-0 either starts looking like a real club or starts quoting last year’s 6-11 as a ghost story.

lastGameReview.label: Week 3 · Sun, Sep 27 · 12:00 PM CT
lastGameReview.lede: Kansas City went to Hard Rock Stadium and came home 3-0 with a 24-10 win. Mahomes was 20-of-24 for 246 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception with zero sacks and a 119.8 rating. Walker carried 18 times for 70 yards, added a 5-yard catch at Q2 12:58, and finished with 73 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns. Rice caught 7 for 88, and Bolton led the defense with 11 tackles. Miami outgained almost nobody (329 to 334) and still held the football 34:21 to Kansas City’s 25:39.

analysis.body: The opening score was a drive, not a trick. At Q1 14:55 Mahomes hit Kelce deep middle for 48 yards to the Miami 19. At Q1 12:54, 2:06 into the game, J. Moore reported in as eligible and Walker went up the middle for 10 yards and the touchdown. Kansas City 7-0. Miami answered with a 3-yard touchdown at Q1 3:27 to tie it 7-7, then Kansas City took a 14-7 lead on Walker’s 5-yard catch at Q2 12:58. From there the game became a possession argument Miami was winning on paper and losing on the scoreboard.

Mahomes’ 20-of-24 was the separator. He was not running for his life — zero sacks — but Miami recorded 5 QB hits on Mahomes. Kansas City recorded 1 QB hit. The ball still came out on time to Rice (7 for 88), Gray (the 24-yarder to the Miami 8 at Q4 13:47), Worthy, and Thornton. The miss that hurt was the Q2 2:00 interception: shotgun, deep middle for Rice, J. Rodriguez, 18-yard return. The red-zone stall that hurt was Q2 6:15, H. Nourzad eligible, Walker up the middle for no gain, turnover on downs at the Miami 12.

Steve Spagnuolo’s front did not get Willis on the ground — 20-of-36, zero sacks, 61.1 rating — and Ollie Gordon II worked 17 rushes plus 3 catches for 20 touches while De'Von Achane was limited to 3 rushes. Miami still turned it over twice. L. Sneed forced and recovered the Willis fumble at Q2 3:16 after Kansas City challenged the down-by-contact ruling. Karlaftis intercepted Willis short right at Q4 2:03, intended for Ryan Miller, with Chris Jones on the play. A later C. Roland-Wallace interception was wiped by a Karlaftis illegal-use-of-hands penalty. Miami’s 37-yard field goal at Q3 10:10 made it 14-10; Kansas City’s 34-yard field goal at Q4 11:35 made it 17-10; an 11-yard touchdown at Q4 2:55 closed it 24-10. Harrison Butker then missed a 50-yarder wide left at Q4 0:57.

The third-down and clock tape is the part that will not flatter anyone in Las Vegas. Kansas City went 3-of-7 and ran 25 times for 88 yards. Miami went 8-of-16, ran 31 times for 119, and sat on 34:21. Both clubs ran 9 drives. Efficiency beat volume in Miami. Crosby will not volunteer that trade.

takeaways.title: Efficiency covered a lost clock
takeaways.body: Mahomes’ 20-of-24 for 246 and the explosive shots produced 24 points on 18 first downs. Miami’s 19 first downs and 34:21 of possession did not produce a second touchdown after Q1. That math travels until an opponent finishes the red zone Kansas City left on the 12.

takeaways.title: The run game showed the identity, not the volume
takeaways.body: Walker’s 18 carries for 70 yards and the 10-yard touchdown are the feature. The team number is 88 yards on 25 attempts. Johnson added 6 rushes. Against a 3-0 Raiders front, 88 is a starting point, not a finished product.

takeaways.title: The defense created the margin without a sack
takeaways.body: Zero sacks, 1 QB hit, and still two Miami turnovers. Credit L. Sneed for the forced and recovered fumble and Karlaftis for the interception. Bolton’s 11 tackles were the tackling tape. The next snap is Crosby and a quarterback who will make Kansas City prove it can finish drives and get off the field on third down.

whatWorked: Mahomes 20-of-24, 246 yards, two passing touchdowns, 119.8 rating, zero sacks
Walker’s 10-yard touchdown 2:06 into the game after Kelce’s 48-yard catch
Rice’s 7 catches for 88 yards, including the 34-yarder to the Miami 15
L. Sneed forcing and recovering the Willis fumble; Karlaftis intercepting Willis at Q4 2:03
Gray’s 24-yard catch to the Miami 8 to set up the 34-yard field goal
whatDidnt: Team rushing stuck at 88 yards on 25 carries
Mahomes’ interception deep middle for Rice; turnover on downs at the Miami 12
Five QB hits on Mahomes; Butker’s 50-yard miss; Karlaftis’ penalty wiping the late interception

currentState.lede: The live record is 3-0. The live questions are the ones Miami left on the table: 88 rushing yards, 3-of-7 on third down, 25:39 of possession, a left tackle in Josh Simmons who has not debuted because of a bulging disk, and a division road game against a 3-0 Raiders club Reid already called aggressive.

workOn.title: Win first down so third down is not a passing down
workOn.body: Kansas City was 3-of-7 on third down in Miami and ran for 88 yards. Allegiant with Crosby on the edge is where obvious passing downs get expensive. Walker’s 20 touches have to start drives, not just finish them.

workOn.title: Protect the pocket without turning Mahomes into a statue
workOn.body: Crosby is a different rusher than what Miami just put on the tape. Boots, slides, and chips are the Week 4 install, not a hope that 20-of-24 repeats itself in a clean pocket.

workOn.title: Get off the field on third down
workOn.body: Miami converted 8-of-16 and held the ball 34:21. Spagnuolo recorded 0 sacks and 1 QB hit. Cover-2 and the zone blitz are on the call sheet because Las Vegas will keep the football if Kansas City lets another offense live on third-and-medium.

workOn.title: Left tackle plan without Simmons
workOn.body: Reid said Simmons has a bulging disk in his lower back and the 2026 debut has not happened. Crosby is the next snap. That is a protection problem and a run-game problem on the same side of the line.

thinkAbout.title: Is Rice the WR1, or is the WR1 still a committee?
thinkAbout.body: Rice went 7 for 88 in Miami and looks like himself again without the offense crowning a single alpha. Worthy, Thornton, Kelce, and Gray all took shots. Allegiant will tell you if that spread is a feature or a tell.

thinkAbout.title: How much Johnson next to Walker
thinkAbout.body: Walker handled 18 rushes and 2 catches. Johnson had 6 rushes. The Indianapolis game was 152 rushing yards as a team; Miami was 88. The staff has to decide if 24 combined carries is enough when the Raiders are 3-0 and playing downhill.

thinkAbout.title: Sneed’s availability after a limited Wednesday
thinkAbout.body: Sneed forced and recovered the Willis fumble, left, and returned in Miami. He was limited on the Wednesday report. A 3-0 Raiders passing game with Brock Bowers in the building is a bad week to guess on a corner.

thinkAbout.title: What 3-0 is actually worth
thinkAbout.body: Last year’s 6-11 is history, not the live record. Polymarket at 8.6 percent to win the Super Bowl still treats three wins as a sample. A road division game against another 3-0 club is how that sample either holds or starts leaking.

gamePlan.lede: Week 4 at Las Vegas is 3-0 versus 3-0 for the AFC West lead through four games, CBS, Sun Oct 4, 3:25 PM CT. Reid called the Raiders aggressive. Mahomes wants bragging rights over Crosby. Kansas City is a 70.0 percent FPI favorite and -4.5 at DraftKings. That number assumes the Miami efficiency travels and the Miami clock does not.
gamePlan.howTheyMatch: Both clubs are 3-0. Kansas City’s offense is Mahomes plus a Walker-led run game that just posted 88 yards; Las Vegas’ defense is Crosby and an aggressive front under Klint Kubiak. Kansas City’s defense is Spagnuolo, Jones, Karlaftis, and Bolton, coming off 0 sacks and 1 QB hit against Willis. Las Vegas could be short a blocker on Jones’s side. The leverage points are Crosby versus Kansas City’s unprotected left edge, Jones versus that interior, Walker versus Las Vegas’ early-down defense, and whether Spagnuolo can keep Bowers and the Raiders’ backs from turning third down into another 34-minute afternoon.

keys.title: Move Mahomes off the spot
keys.body: Five hits in Miami with zero sacks is the warning, not the comfort. Boot, slide, and get Crosby playing contain. If Kansas City sits in a static pocket, Allegiant becomes a hitting drill even if the sack column stays clean.

keys.title: Run Walker early so the play-action boot is earned
keys.body: Team rushing was 88 in Miami. Crosby will not respect play fake if the under-center zone is a give-up down. Walker’s 18-carry tape has to show up on first down, with Johnson as the change-up.

keys.title: Jones into the interior, Karlaftis into the plan
keys.body: The Raiders could be missing a key blocker against Jones. That is the one-on-one Kansas City should hunt. Do not wait for 0 sacks to become the weekly identity.

keys.title: Take away the explosive to Bowers
keys.body: Miami’s 42-yarder to Greg Dulcich was the deep-middle reminder. Cover-2 and two-high answers keep Bowers from ending drives. Make Las Vegas drive the field the way Miami did — then finish the stop Kansas City did not always get on third down.

keys.title: Win the possession fight you just lost
keys.body: Kansas City had the ball 25:39 in Miami. Nine drives each, and the Dolphins still sat on 34:21. Against another 3-0 club, that is how favorites become 3-1.

script: Open in 12 personnel with Walker on under-center inside zone; four yards is a win if it keeps Crosby honest.
Second-and-medium: play-action boot away from Crosby, Kelce and Gray as the easy reads on the move.
Third-and-5: mesh to Rice and Kelce, Johnson as the checkdown if Kubiak walks a fifth rusher.
If Crosby wins upfield, spacing screen to Walker or Johnson and let the line lead in space.
Second-and-long vs Las Vegas: Spagnuolo zone blitz — show heat, drop a lineman, Jones and a linebacker exchange. Steal the down; do not hunt a takeaway that is not there.
Third-and-7+: Cover-2 shell, Bolton and Drue Tranquill rallying to Bowers and the back, two-deep to take away the shot.

nextGame.label: Week 4 · Sun, Oct 4 · 3:25 PM CT
nextGame.note: 3-0 vs. 3-0 for the AFC West lead through four games, Sun Oct 4, 3:25 PM CT

spotlight.title: Mahomes wants the Crosby snap
spotlight.body: Mahomes is talking bragging rights with Maxx Crosby, a rivalry that never shares a huddle and always shares a Sunday. Zero sacks in Miami, but 5 QB hits. Crosby is the rusher who turns that clean column into a problem if the left tackle plan without Simmons leaks.

spotlight.title: Simmons’ disk is still the unanswered question
spotlight.body: Reid said Josh Simmons has a bulging disk in his lower back, which is why the 2026 debut has not happened. A road game against Crosby is a brutal way to keep answering that question with backups and chips.

spotlight.title: Rice is producing without wearing the WR1 crown
spotlight.body: Rice’s 7-for-88 night is the volume line, not a coronation. The same Miami drive chart also paid Kelce, Gray, Worthy, and Thornton, and Las Vegas is the first test of whether 246 yards still show up when the defense knows the ball will move around.

spotlight.title: Walker is the feature. 88 yards is the team number.
spotlight.body: Walker leads the NFL in rushing through three weeks and just handled 20 touches (18 rushes, 2 catches) for 73 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns — a 10-yard run, plus a 5-yard catch at Q2 12:58. The box that travels is Kansas City’s 88 rushing yards. Allegiant is where the feature back needs the line to finish the identity.

spotlight.title: Jones vs. a Raiders line that may be short a blocker
spotlight.body: Kansas City recorded 0 sacks and 1 QB hit in Miami. The next interior test is Jones against a Raiders line that could be missing a key blocker. That is the one mismatch Spagnuolo should keep calling until Las Vegas proves it can handle it.

spotlight.title: Gray just asked for more than the blocking job
spotlight.body: Gray’s 24-yard catch to the Miami 8 was his loudest receiving tape in this sample, and it set up the 34-yard field goal that made it 17-10. With Kelce still taking the deep-middle shot (48 yards), Gray is the 12-personnel weapon Bieniemy can use to keep Crosby guessing.

matchups.unit: Mahomes / LT plan vs. Maxx Crosby
matchups.note: Kansas City allowed 5 QB hits with 0 sacks in Miami and is still without Simmons. Crosby is the rusher who makes that edge the game.

matchups.opponent: Las Vegas interior OL (possibly short a blocker)
matchups.note: The Raiders may be missing a key blocker in front of Jones. After 0 sacks in Miami, this is the one-on-one Kansas City should hunt.
Walker’s 70 yards on 18 carries is the player line; 88 as a team is the truth. A 3-0 Raiders front will not give those yards free.
Cover-2 and the zone blitz are how Kansas City keeps Bowers from giving Allegiant another long afternoon. Miami converted 8-of-16 third downs and held 34:21.

matchups.chiefs: Rashee Rice, Travis Kelce, Noah Gray
matchups.note: Rice 7-88, Kelce’s 48-yarder, Gray’s 24-yarder. If Mahomes gets time, the skill tape from Miami is the edge.

xsandos.title: Walker under-center inside zone
xsandos.situation: 1st-and-10 vs. Las Vegas, 12 personnel, early in the series
xsandos.why: Kansas City ran 25 times for 88 yards in Miami; Walker needs those early-down yards in Allegiant so Crosby is playing the run instead of hunting Mahomes on second and third down.
xsandos.coaching: Walker, one cut, pad level. Johnson is the next-man change-up, not a committee argument. Extra linemen (Nourzad, Caliendo, Moore) only on the snaps they report — win the down, keep the series on schedule.

xsandos.title: Boot Mahomes away from Crosby
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-6 vs. Las Vegas, Crosby aligned over the left edge
xsandos.why: Five QB hits in Miami with zero sacks is the warning label. The boot puts Mahomes on the perimeter, turns Crosby into a contain player, and gives Kelce and Gray the easy moving-pocket reads.
xsandos.coaching: Sell Walker. Mahomes gets depth, then width. Kelce over the ball, Gray in the flat, Rice on the deep crosser. If Crosby crashes, throw the flat; if he contains, hit the intermediate window behind him.

xsandos.title: Mesh to Rice and Kelce
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-5 vs. Las Vegas, Kubiak walking extra hats
xsandos.why: Kansas City was 3-of-7 on third down in Miami. Rice’s 7 catches and Kelce’s deep-middle presence give Mahomes a rub answer when the Raiders play the aggressive football Reid already flagged.
xsandos.coaching: Rice and Kelce cross at six yards and pick clean. Gray sits, Johnson is the outlet. Mahomes takes the first opening — do not hold for the shot when a 6-yard win keeps Crosby off the next down.

xsandos.title: Walker / Johnson spacing screen
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-8 vs. Las Vegas, Crosby upfield after a win on first down
xsandos.why: If Las Vegas sells out to put hits on Mahomes, the screen is how Walker’s 20-touch role and Johnson’s 6-rush change-up punish that aggression without asking the left tackle to win a vacuum.
xsandos.coaching: Mahomes sells the drop. The line gets out in space. Walker or Johnson catch, north, and let Rice and Gray finish the perimeter blocks. This is easy offense when Crosby’s ears are pinned.

xsandos.title: Cover-2 vs. Bowers on third down
xsandos.situation: 3rd-and-7, Raiders 11 personnel, Bowers in the slot
xsandos.why: Miami converted 8-of-16 third downs, hit Dulcich for 42 down the middle, and held the ball 34:21. Two-deep, five-under takes away the shot to Bowers and makes Las Vegas drive the field.
xsandos.coaching: Safeties split the posts. Corners squat. Bolton and Tranquill rally to Bowers and the back. Tackle, get off the field, and do not donate another 34-minute possession.

xsandos.title: Spagnuolo zone blitz, steal the down
xsandos.situation: 2nd-and-10 vs. Las Vegas, Jones inside, a linebacker walking
xsandos.why: The zone blitz is the call to use against Kubiak’s aggressive offense after Kansas City posted 0 sacks and 1 QB hit in Miami — show heat, drop a lineman, make Las Vegas throw to a window Spagnuolo owns.
xsandos.coaching: Jones stabs. A linebacker comes. A lineman drops into the throwing lane. Karlaftis and Bolton exchange jobs on the call. Hunt a hurried throw and a long third down, not a takeaway that is not on the card.

coaching.detail: Reid called the 3-0 Raiders ‘aggressive football.’ Kubiak’s first-year staff will test Kansas City’s left edge and third-down defense. The Chiefs’ answer has to be structure — boots, extra hats on reported snaps, Cover-2 — not a 20-of-24 rerun in a static pocket.

Walker is the feature (18 carries, 70 yards, 20 touches in Miami) and the team still posted 88 rushing yards. Inside zone and the play-action boot are how Bieniemy keeps Crosby from turning Allegiant into a passing-down game.

Zero sacks and 1 QB hit against Willis is not the look Kansas City wants heading into a 3-0 opponent. Cover-2 to take away Bowers and the zone blitz to steal second-and-long are the two calls that have to show up on the sheet.

injuries.note: Reid said Simmons has a bulging disk in his lower back. He was DNP Wednesday; ESPN lists him Questionable and no game status has been issued yet.
Sneed forced and recovered the Willis fumble in Miami, returned in that game, and was listed as limited on the Chiefs’ Wednesday injury report ahead of Las Vegas.

personnel.detail: The 2026 debut has not happened. Protection vs. Crosby will run through chips, slides, extra linemen on reported snaps, and getting Mahomes off the spot.

personnel.move: Walker as the feature, Johnson as the change-up
personnel.detail: Walker: 18 rushes, 2 catches, 20 touches, 73 scrimmage yards and two touchdowns in Miami (10-yard run, 5-yard catch at Q2 12:58). Johnson: 6 rushes. Team rushing: 88 yards on 25 attempts. That split is the live identity.
Rice 7-88 is the volume. Kelce took the 48-yard deep-middle shot. Gray’s 24-yarder to the 8 is the case for more 12 personnel against an aggressive Raiders front.

strategies: Chip and slide to Crosby; boot Mahomes on second-and-medium rather than asking a static pocket to repeat 20-of-24.
Commit to Walker on first down (inside zone) so Las Vegas cannot pin its ears back.
Use Gray and extra reported linemen in 12/13 to keep the edge honest without pretending Simmons is available.
Hunt Jones into an interior that may be missing a blocker; do not live with another 0-sack, 1-hit afternoon.
Win the clock: 25:39 in Miami is not a winning possession number against another 3-0 club.
Cover-2 on third-and-long to take away Bowers; zone blitz on second-and-long to steal the down.
debates: Is 3-0 vs. 3-0 in Las Vegas the real West measuring stick, or is -4.5 still underselling Crosby?
Should Kansas City keep feeding Walker 18-plus carries even if the team number stays near 88?
Does Rice’s 7-88 close the WR1 argument, or is the committee the point of this offense?
How long can the line survive Crosby with Simmons still on a bulging disk?
Is Spagnuolo’s 0-sack Miami tape a blip or the start of a third-down problem?

runOfShow.talkTrack: Twenty of twenty-four. Twenty-four to ten. Miami had the football 34:21. We are 3-0, and the tape that travels is 88 rushing yards and 3-of-7 on third down. Las Vegas is next, Sun Oct 4, 3:25 PM CT.

Walk the scoring: Walker 10-yard TD 2:06 into the game, Miami 3-yard TD to tie, Walker 5-yard catch TD for 14-7, Miami 37-yard field goal, Kansas City 34-yard field goal, 11-yard TD to make it 24-10. Credit L. Sneed for the fumble, Karlaftis for the interception, Bolton for 11 tackles. Do not dress 0 sacks up as a party.

Week 2 vs Indianapolis: KC 523 yards, 29 first downs, 371 net passing, 152 rushing, 37:00 of possession, a 33-30 overtime win. Week 3 at Miami: KC 334 yards, 18 first downs, 246 net passing, 88 rushing, 25:39. Same 3-0, different box. Simmons’ disk, Sneed limited, Crosby waiting. FPI 70.0 percent is a favorite, not a bye.

Both 3-0. Reid said aggressive football. The Mahomes–Crosby snap is the Sunday argument. Jones may see a Raiders line missing a blocker. Walker vs. their front. Bowers vs. Cover-2. West lead through four games.
Four offense: inside zone, play-action boot, mesh, spacing screen. Two defense: Cover-2 and the zone blitz as a call, not a takeaway credit. Tie every card to Crosby, Jones, Walker, Rice, Bowers.

Simmons Questionable (back), DNP Wednesday, no game status yet. Sneed limited Wednesday after the fumble-and-return in Miami. Rice 7-88. Gray’s 24-yarder. Walker 20 touches, 73 scrimmage yards, two touchdowns. Johnson 6 rushes.
Sun Oct 4, 3:25 PM CT, CBS, Allegiant. Chiefs -4.5, 47.5, FPI 70.0 percent. Polymarket 8.6 percent Super Bowl, 16.5 percent AFC. 3-0 vs. 3-0. See you after the West game.
